root.name: Petrov's Defense: Millennium Attack
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nf6 3. Nxe5 d6 4. Nf3 Nxe4 5. Bd3

overview: After 4...Nxe4 White plays 5.Bd3 instead of the main 5.d4, aiming to follow with d4 and castling and often reaching Petrov main-line positions. Black plays ...d5, ...Be7 and ...Nc6 with a symmetrical structure and equality; the position is solid and drawish.

white_ideas.idea: Play d4 and Re1 against the e4 knight

black_ideas.idea: Trade the e4 knight and castle

typical_structures.structure: Symmetrical Petrov structure with the open e-file

character.notes: Petrov, known for solid defence and a drawish reputation.

gambit.notes: No material is given on purpose in the main line.

structure.notes: Symmetrical exchange structure with the e-file.

approach.notes: A sideline in a main Petrov, standard.

character.reason: Petrov lines are Solid and drawish.

gambit.reason: The e-pawn is recovered at once.
